caption: The drawing depicts an ornate metal spur with a large, round, and toothed rowel (the rotating wheel with pointed edges) on the left side. The spur is primarily composed of a metallic gray and bronze material, with intricate engraved patterns along its surface. The shank, which extends to the rowel, is adorned with scrolling decorative engravings. Attached to the heel band is a chain made up of several links, including some shaped like flowers, with a prominent flower ornament located near the center. The entire spur is shown with shading that gives a metallic sheen in hues of gray, brown, and greenish patina, set against a plain, off-white background. The drawing is highly detailed, including small attachment loops and screws visible on the spur, and the artist’s signature appears on the bottom right of the image.
title: Spur
